source.method: Connected GitHub full Git-blob read; scoped extraction, not a replacement registry

components.title: Confidential Case Filing Information Sheet - Non-Domestic Relations
components.condition: Include when the filing opens a new civil case or the receiving clerk requires confidential case-filing information.

components.title: Judgment and Order of Expungement - Mistaken Identity
components.condition: Include when required by the court; participant-supplied caption and record-holder identifiers only. Judicial findings, correction directives, date and signature remain for the court.

components.title: Filing and distribution instructions under section 610.145
requirements: Tell dismissal-based participants about the prosecutor/court notice mechanism before asking them to prepare a separate petition.
Identify the court in the county where the matter was last pending for the petition route.
Preserve later signature, judicial and clerk distribution fields.
State that the court determines expungement; the petition is not an order.

sourceFaceReconciliation.finding: The held OSCA07-17 one-page form has a penalty-of-perjury declaration and signature line, but no separate verification-date field. Preserve the signature; do not draw a new date or notarial act to satisfy a manifest label.

The held FI-05 requests full SSN when the party is a person and it is reasonably available. Last four digits do not satisfy that source instruction. This scoped builder accepts only a supplied full SSN; missing availability must be checked before filing, not coerced to a last-four fill.
